angleRead.name: Jordan Velez
angleRead.text: I'm standing at the counter at Art Walk Cafe, watching Brady Lopez work the dish pit behind the pastry case. The place is doing fine — steady, small, the kind of business that doesn't make noise but keeps the block honest. But the real story in Uptown this cycle is the gap between the big and the small. Oakland Tech Collective is adding people, Ridgeline Studio is adding people, and the numbers say both are growing. Meanwhile Art Walk Cafe adds a few thousand in revenue and Night Walk Records is barely moving. Cedric Nakamura is over there at the register six days a week, and I want to know what he sees from behind that counter when the tech crowd walks past on their way to the coworking spa
